lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，保持着距离。
lines.en: I follow you at a fixed distance.
I walk half a step behind your flank.
My red scales darken in the light.
I step in the prints you've left.
I keep two paces off, no more, no less.

lines.zh: 我经过门槛，低了一下头。
lines.en: I dip my head at the threshold.
I go around a pile of timber.

lines.zh: 我走的时候不发出声音。
lines.en: I make no sound as I walk.
My wings are folded tight.
I walk from shadow into light.
I follow the grass you've trampled down.

lines.zh: 我又退回到原来的距离。
lines.en: I fall back to my old distance.
I stand straight, waiting for orders.
I keep my head turned your way.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴贴着地面不动。
lines.en: My tail lies on the ground, still.
Every scale on me is closed.

lines.zh: 我只看前面那一个方向。
lines.en: I look only at that one direction.
I'm waiting for you to raise your hand.
I breathe very lightly.
My claw tips rest on the ground.
I'm ready for anything.
I haven't shifted an inch.
I hear your footsteps.
I dip my head slightly.

lines.zh: 风把我的翅膀吹开一点。
lines.en: The wind opens my wings a little.
I close them at once.

lines.zh: 你不说话，我就这么等着。
lines.en: If you say nothing, I'll keep waiting.

lines.zh: 我的头随你的手偏过去。
lines.en: My head turns with your hand.

lines.zh: 你看哪，我的眼就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you look, my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 你的手指一弯，我就懂了。
lines.en: Your fingers curl, and I understand.
I straighten up at once.
You say nothing; neither do I.
My wings open slightly.
I'm waiting for you to point a way.

lines.zh: 你落脚有多轻，我记下了。
lines.en: I've noted how lightly you set your feet.
My teeth stay sheathed.
I edge a little nearer, then stop.
Back to my spot, I set my stance again.
I step back and return to my place.

lines.zh: 这一下让我低了一下头。
lines.en: That makes my head dip.
My scales flare and close.

lines.zh: 我把疼咽下去，姿态没乱。
lines.en: I swallow the pain; my stance holds.
I lower my head and look at the cut.
I square myself again.
One leg won't quite hold me.
I brace and hold.
I wait for your next order.
I can still stand like this.
You don't eat; neither do I.

lines.zh: 那东西我不认识，先不动。
lines.en: I don't know that thing; I hold still.
I hold still and let you decide.
I won't touch that.
I give it one glance downward.

lines.zh: 那不在今天给我的命令里。
lines.en: That wasn't in the orders I was given today.
I shake my head and step back.

lines.zh: 没吩咐过的东西，我不碰。
lines.en: Anything unasked for, I leave alone.
My claw prints still mark the spot.
I wait for you to say it again.
I yield half a step, then straighten again.
I don't strike back.

lines.zh: 我重新站到原来的位置。
lines.en: I return to my old position.

lines.zh: 被撞歪了，我把脚挪回去。
lines.en: Knocked askew, I shift my feet back.
I put my foot back.
A little dirt falls off me.
I look down at you.
I square my stance again.
I wait for your reaction.

lines.zh: 被撞了，我把爪子钉住地。
lines.en: Bumped, I dig my claws into the ground.
She stands not far from me.
Her red scales look much like mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起把头转向门口。
lines.en: We both turn our heads to the door.
She comes a little closer.
We speak only with our eyes.
Her tail brushes mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起等同一个命令。
lines.en: We wait for the same order.
Her breathing is as light as mine.
Day breaks, and neither of us moves.
She returns to her post.
I pinch it between my teeth, steady.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它推到你跟前。
lines.en: I nudge it over to you with a claw.
I nudge it with a claw.
I don't put it in my mouth.
I hold it and wait for you to speak.
It slips out of my claws.

lines.zh: 我把它搁回刚才的地方。
lines.en: I set it back where it was.
I hold it steady and don't move.
I look at it, then at you.
I bring it before you.
I see where you're pointing.
My head turns that way.
I straighten at once.
My scales flare once.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向迈出一步。
lines.en: I take one step that way.
I wait for you to nod again.

lines.zh: 我把胸挺起来，等你点头。
lines.en: I square my chest and wait for your nod.
My claws grip the ground.
I lower myself and go still.
Is that the target.
I've taken the first step.
I do exactly as you say.
Wherever you point, that's where I press.
I've fixed on that direction.
I follow step by step.
I'm half a step behind your flank.
You raise a hand and I press in.
I keep my eyes ahead.
A stone in the path; I avoid it.
I make no call.

lines.zh: 翅膀贴着背，我等你示意。
lines.en: Wings tight to my back, I wait for your signal.

lines.zh: 你没下令，我就压着步子。
lines.en: No order yet, so I hold my pace.
Something ahead is retreating.

lines.zh: 我跟紧半步，贴着你的侧后。
lines.en: I close half a step, at your flank.
You've nodded.
Then I won't wait.
I sweep round on the flank.

lines.zh: 我抢在它前面，替你挡住。
lines.en: I get in front of it and block for you.
I'm already right at it.
My jaws sink into its shoulder.
My claws sweep in from the side.
That only tears a strip.
I bite down and fling it aside.
It's not down yet; I bite once more.
It blocks my claws.
I pin it and wait for a word from you.
It's still struggling.
I wait for you to say another word.
You said nothing, so I don't let go.
Blood spatters my scales.

lines.zh: 收口之后，我先看你一眼。
lines.en: After the bite, I look to you first.
I slowly open my jaws.
I step back to your side.

lines.zh: 我从红鳞的光里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the red sheen.
I fold my wings.
I look at you first.
Then I lower my head.
I'm waiting for your first word.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上压了一下。
lines.en: My claws press the ground once.
I don't step away.
I stand half a step behind you.
The wind here is a little cool.
I raise my head and look ahead.
My tail hangs low.
I've just set my feet; I haven't moved.
I wait for you to use the ring.
I square my stance.
I let my breath settle and take my place.
I've been right here all along.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的鳞，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Fire rakes my scales and I shudder.
My stance breaks apart in the fall.
Water floods in and I thrash.
The blast shoves me back half a step.
Something lodges between my scales.
The light jolts through me.
Too starved, I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷击在鳞上，我抖得厉害。
lines.en: Lightning hits my scales and I shake hard.
No ground below; I fall.
